mx.teacher_note: Net-like pattern: parallel venation. Parallel veins: reticulate venation.

intelligence.enrichment: The thin lines seen on leaves are veins, and the pattern of veins is called venation; a net-like pattern on both sides of a thick middle vein is reticulate venation, while parallel veins indicate parallel venation. leaf_vein_pattern -> venation_type The learner correctly applies this rule: The thin lines seen on leaves are veins, and the pattern of veins is called venation; a net-like pattern on both sides of a thick middle vein is reticulate venation, while parallel veins indicate parallel venation. Venation means the overall shape or colour of a leaf, so any attractive leaf pattern can be called reticulate.
